67065: Hachiman is an isolated, friendless boy who is pragmatic to a fault. His most prominent feature is his set of "dead fish-eyes." He firmly believes that "youth" is simply an illusion created by hypocrites, for hypocrites, born from the ashes of past failures.
67067: Yukino is the leader of the Service Club, of which she is the sole member until Hachiman joins her. She is smart, beautiful, and is nicknamed the "Ice-cold Beauty" for her icy demeanor.
67069: Yui is a cheerful, outgoing girl who becomes the Service Club's first "customer", asking them to help her bake cookies for "a certain someone". Her problems lie not with her personality, but with her inability to deal with issues by herself.
67071: Saika is a member of the tennis club who has a feminine appearance, but prefers others to not mistake his gender. He is called "The Prince" by his female classmates. On their first meeting, Saika asks help from Hachiman to join the tennis club, which was brushed off by Yukino.
67073: Zaimokuza is a student from class 2C who suffers from adolescent delusions. He displays a high interest in historical shoguns, magic, and writing (despite the fact he is a terrible writer), and video game creation. He often talks like a movie narrator or with grandiose overtones.
67075: Hachiman's younger sister who is very different than her brother. She's cheerful and lively and is part of her school's student council.
67077: Shizuka is Hachiman's teacher, a language teacher who serves as his futures advisor/counselor. She is aware of Hachiman's supposed "problems", and takes steps to ensure he is freed from them, her first move being to force him into joining the Service Club.
74587: Hachiman Hikigaya's classmate who seems like a delinquent, but wants to make friends. She cares deeply for her brother as she hid her name and age to work in night-shift part-time jobs in order to pay school fees and reduce her family's load.
74589: Saki's younger brother who requested the group's help as to find out about his sister's nightly activities. Which he later found out that her sister is working as a bar tender under a false name and age to support his cram school tuition.
79589: Yukino's elder sister who is even more outstanding than Yukino. However, unlike Yukino, she shows a good attitude towards other people, even if she has to lie about her true feelings most of the time.
79591: He is a very popular guy in Hikki and Yui's class, who is good in almost everything.
79593: She is Hikki and Yui's classmate who is very popular in Class 2-F, as well as the main female figure in Hayato Hayama's clique. Yumiko's personality is pompous. Due to her popularity, she is held in highest hierarchy.
79595: Hina is a classmate of Yui and Hachiman, who is a quiet girl and hangs around Yumiko. She is a fujoshi, which is why other boys from her class are always avoiding her.
82543: Kakeru is one of Hayato's friends. He is in the football club. He has feelings for Hina and is the only guy in class who often supports Hina's scripts.
82545: Yamato is one of Hayato's friends. He is in the rugby club.
82547: Oooka is one of Hayato's friends. He is in the baseball club.
83657: Atsugi is a physical education teacher in Sōbu High School.
84613: Rumi is a lonely primary school student who is openly despised by her peers. Hayato at first tried to resolve the situation through talking to her in front of her classmates, which instead attracted more hateful attention to her.
85283: Minami is the leader of the second most influential clique in class 2F, and holds a grudge towards Yui, who she was friendly with in their first high school year, for being in the superior clique.
86015: Meguri is a third year student and the president of Sobu High School's student council. Although she is not a reliable leader herself, her personality has brought her immense support from the councilors and thus she is able to unite the student council.
88727: Iroha is a 1st-year student of class 1-C in Sobu High school, introduced in Volume 7.5. Hachiman sees her as a “not cute Komachi” or a “better version of Sagami.
129150: Tamanawa is the head of the planning committee for the Christmas festival. He really likes synergy and has shown a talent in freestyle rap.
149026: Hachiman and Kaori both went to the same junior school. Hachiman also used to like her and asked her out before.
181120: The younger sister of Saki Kawasaki.
187653: Yui's mother. She seems to be lenient, kind, friendly person being mostly like Yui herself.
191684: Mother of Yukino and Haruno Yukinoshita Described as a scary person she makes all the decisions for the family which they all have to compromise.
